text:
Alicia: Quick sync — noticed overlap between SI intake and marketplace leads this week. Which signal should trigger partner claim? Options I can think of: demo scheduled, pipeline stage -> 'qualified', or explicit marketplace opt-in on the form. Thoughts?
Dmitri: demo scheduled + ARR filter sounds best. demo events are high intent and less noisy. maybe ARR > $50k to avoid tiny deals.
Maya: +1 to demo + ARR threshold. also we need a conflict window — if two partners claim same account we should surface a dispute workflow (48h to respond).
Leo: For account mapping, let's use fuzzy-match score > 0.85 and require AM manual override if below threshold. Also include a small grace for subsidiaries.
Alicia: @Jen can you add an intake webhook rule to tag leads with `si_claim_candidate` when demo=true and ARR>50000? We'll then fanout to partner queue.
Jen: Yep — I can add that. I'll push a tiny service that adds the tag and posts to #partnerships-intake. Will set flag `si_claim_pending` so frontend shows a pending state. ETA EOD.
Maya: Proposal: fallback rule — if partner doesn't accept claim within 72h, auto-return to origin owner and nudge AM.
Dmitri: Also flagging hardware-only partners: we should treat them as BCC recipients on co-sell invites (they get notified but not primary owner) to avoid ownership churn.
Alicia: Great catch. I'll draft a one-pager with rules and sample intake flow (webhook -> tag -> partner queue -> accept/timeout -> assign). Will share for review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
